name: ctx-bar
description: Live context-window bar in the status line: fill, tokens/window, cache share, auto-compact headroom, cost

showCost.title: Show session cost
showCost.description: Show the session's cost in the status line

warnAt.title: Warn at percent
warnAt.description: Prefix the line with ! at or above this fill percentage

pricingFile.title: Price table file
pricingFile.description: JSON price table (USD per million tokens per model); relative to the session's working directory, or absolute. Read once at session start

costSource.title: Cost source
costSource.description: Where the $ figure comes from: engine (default), table (your pricingFile), or both
